file_stem: RWB E1 007 Integration adapters for outbound files
title: Integration adapters for outbound files
status_text: Ready. Inbound removed; gate waits for ACE-001
goal: One outbound adapter with data-driven retry and an owned exception queue, so failed files surface the same day
why: The old inbound loaders are gone: ACE ingests every source. What stays is sending files out (WIN notices, lake extracts, debt-sale tape) safely and visibly.

ace.note: addressee for WIN notices (INT-14) by contact_key
account_key, account_code for the debt-sale tape (INT-25)
readiness: build only when the batch is COMPLETE

writes.note: one row per file; SENT, ACKNOWLEDGED or EXCEPTION
owner task when the retry limit is reached

stores: SFTP outbound folders + key store; document store container (TE-012); data lake (INT-19/20); WIN (INT-14); Log Analytics alerts on held and failed items

functions.name: OutboundFileAdapterImpl
functions.does: build file from tables and views

rules: BR2: ACE is read only via recovery.v_ace_* by business key; the adapter never writes ACE
BR3: a file is built only when the ACE batch is COMPLETE
BR9: no inbound adapter; interface_config holds OUTBOUND rows only
BR10: an item carries case IDs and keys, never names or addresses
risks: Batch not COMPLETE -> no file built (MSG-P1-001)
Retry limit reached -> exception queue + owner task (MSG-P2-001)
example: INT-14 config: max 3 attempts at 5 / 15 / 45 min, owner RW-PLATADM
JOB-10 builds WIN_NOTICE_20261110.txt with addressees from v_ace_contact by contact_key
No read of any public table
